about: Every place the mod touches Half Sword. v0.2 names come from the public Dumper-7 SDK of Half Sword Early Access (lambor590/Half-Sword-Enhancer, 2026-09-22) and the universal-modder field note; Blueprint names use spaces where the SDK shows underscores.

columns.name: exact UE path or FName (spaces are real)
columns.used_for: what the mod does with it

rows.name: /Game/Character/Blueprints/Willie_BP.Willie_BP_C
rows.used_for: spawning gauntlet fighters; finding all fighters

rows.name: Team Int
rows.used_for: putting gauntlet fighters on a team against the player

rows.name: Mesh
rows.used_for: the fighter's SkeletalMeshComponent: bone transforms, hiding the body, attaching Halo pieces

rows.name: /Script/Engine.PlayerController:ClientRestart
rows.used_for: re-arming the mod after a level (re)start

rows.name: /Script/ProceduralMeshComponent.ProceduralMeshComponent
rows.used_for: building the Halo model pieces at runtime

rows.name: /Engine/EngineDebugMaterials/VertexColorMaterial.VertexColorMaterial
rows.used_for: material for the tinted Halo pieces

rows.name: Remove Armor
rows.used_for: strip_armor: (SpawnTransform, Slot 0-9, Disable Collision With, out Spawned Armor) per slot

rows.name: Free Mode Activated
rows.used_for: the gauntlet runs only in Free play
rows.source: SDK GI_Settings_C.Free_Mode_Activated; set by Enhancer's map loader

rows.name: Map_Arena_
rows.used_for: the gauntlet runs only on arena maps (Map_Arena_Pit, _Yard, _LordsHall, ...)

rows.name: BP_SpawnerPoint_Willies_C
rows.used_for: the arena's own fighter spawner, used for waves 2 and 3 (full character setup)

rows.name: /Script/Engine.GameplayStatics:BeginDeferredActorSpawnFromClass
rows.used_for: fallback when no spawner exists: deferred spawn with AdjustIfPossibleButAlwaysSpawn, as Half Sword Enhancer does
